title: Tricksters: An Introduction — Crash Course World Mythology #20
summary: An introduction to the trickster across myth traditions, from Anansi to Br’er Rabbit; useful for comparing the category before exploring individual stories.

title: The Myth of Anansi, the Trickster Spider
summary: Emily Zobel Marshall tells an Akan story about Anansi’s bid to acquire stories. Use the linked lesson for context and creator credits.

title: The Myth of Loki and the Master Builder
summary: An animated retelling of Loki and a bargain involving the defenses of Asgard. Compare the plot with other Norse sources.

title: The Myth of Loki and the Deadly Mistletoe
summary: A separate Norse narrative centering on Baldur and Loki; it offers a darker view of the figure’s disruptive role.

title: The Monkey King and the Realm of the Dead
summary: An animated story of Sun Wukong and his resistance to the rules of the underworld, emphasizing the Monkey King’s extraordinary powers.
